_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 1,745 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with 197 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and commercial business customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.58x; +34% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.21; conservative 2yr +17%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -19.9%/yr (worst year FY02-FY11, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.2%/yr (FY12 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +9.2%/yr (FY02-FY11 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +24.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY02-FY11); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2012-08-31) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.58x (47.3% downside to Bear $15 / +29.9% upside to Bull $37) | Adj composite 1.63 vs market 2.84: gap -1.21 [OVERVALUED] | +34% above the EPP floor $21 (13x FY12E $1.64) | Conservative 2-yr case: +17.0% total (+8.5%/yr) | At 17.4x FY12E the 15% hurdle price $38 sits above the BULL case; comps -0.4% in Q2 FY12, forward sales +0% (FY12 sales guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2011 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2007-2011 (fiscal 2011 has 53 weeks), income statement 2009-2011 with percent of sales, 2011 diluted shares 1,273M, interest $371M, income tax provision $1,067M on pre-tax $2,906M; cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow, fixed assets acquired; product-category sales; $2.9B repurchased in 2011, $4.5B authorization remaining; 2011 fourth-quarter dividend $0.14; 1,745 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, 197 million square feet, 27 stores closed; 2009 weighted average diluted shares 1,464M

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2010 10-K
sources.supports: selected financial data 2006-2010, income statement 2008-2010 with percent of sales (store opening costs now inside SG&A, prior years reclassified), 2010 diluted shares 1,403M, interest $332M, effective tax from income tax provision $1,218M on pre-tax $3,228M; cash, short-term investments, operating cash flow, fixed assets acquired; product-category sales; $2.6B repurchased in 2010; 2010 fourth-quarter dividend $0.110; 1,749 stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico, 197 million square feet; 2008 weighted average diluted shares 1,468M (annual report, exhibit 13)

sources.title: Lowe's Companies FY2009 10-K
